zh.title: LATAM獲得5.05億美元融資　將引進11架新客機
zh.summary: LATAM獲得5.05億美元融資；將於2026年引進11架新機以加速機隊更新。
body: 拉丁美洲航空集團（LATAM）已成功完成一項金額達5.05億美元的融資案，將用於籌措2026年引進11架新客機的所需資金。此項融資交易旨在協助該航空公司加速推動機隊更新計畫，強化整體營運佈局。
根據Simple Flying報導，在LATAM預計於2026年接收的11架新客機中，包含4架空中巴士A321neo型客機以及6架巴西航空工業E195-E2型客機。航空公司將藉由這筆5.05億美元的資金注入，落實機隊世代更新目標。

en.title: LATAM Secures $505 Million Financing Deal For 11 New Aircraft In 2026
en.summary: LATAM secures $505 million financing to add 11 new aircraft in 2026, accelerating fleet renewal.
body: LATAM has secured a $505 million financing deal to fund 11 new aircraft scheduled to arrive in 2026, according to details reported by Simple Flying. The newly secured financial arrangement is intended to support the airline group by accelerating its overall fleet renewal process.

The financing agreement covers 11 new aircraft additions in 2026, including four Airbus A321neo aircraft and six Embraer E195-E2 aircraft. The acquisition of these aircraft forms a central component of LATAM's ongoing fleet renewal program.
With $505 million in total funding established for these 11 new aircraft, LATAM is positioned to continue its fleet modernization plans through 2026.
